title: Figure 4: Wellstone Fiber cross-section with conductor, P/N layers and memory
description: Concentric-ring illustration of a notional "Wellstone" fiber, with labels pointing to "Conductors" (yellow segments on the surface), "P-Layer," "N-Layer," "Memory," and a yellow core carrying "Power & Control Signals." The caption describes a flexible cylinder studded with artificial atoms that, when woven, creates a bulk material with programmable properties. The surrounding text discusses future programmable matter and its vulnerabilities to interference and hackers.
